purpose: Separate historical freeze evidence from the current 51-rule audit without silently rewriting either source.

policy.ALIGNED_FROZEN: Freeze backup assertion and current master audit agree.
policy.CONFLICT_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION: The two sources disagree; do not upgrade or downgrade silently.
policy.MASTER_AUDIT_ONLY: Current audit has a status but the 33-rule backup makes no assertion.
